result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: it creates a mutual agreement-wide cap equal to the greater of 12 months’ paid or payable fees and USD 1,000,000, mutually excludes indirect/consequential damages, includes all required uncapped carve-outs, and excludes Client payment obligations from capped damages. The unrelated warranty language is preserved. It is not strictly minimal because it also excludes incidental damages, which the playbook does not require. Drafting is generally professional, though the definition of “Excluded Claims” is grammatically imprecise in referring to a party’s “indemnification obligations” and “gross negligence” as claims.
